name: Zero-field heat-pulse relaxation calorimetry, 2–300 K
description: Measure heat capacity versus temperature using a vacuum microcalorimeter and relaxation fit in the manufacturer-specified zero-field accuracy range.

sources.citation: Quantum Design Heat Capacity Option, 1084-500 Rev. J0

reported_conditions.as_printed: ±5% for 2 K to 300 K, zero field

reported_equipment: PPMS DynaCool with Heat Capacity option

requirements.rationale: The selected measurement range is the brochure's 2–300 K zero-field accuracy interval.
An installed calorimeter puck/heater/thermometer and relaxation acquisition are essential.

missing_information: Sample must fit the 3 x 3 mm platform; thermal contact, addenda calibration and relaxation model suitability require confirmation. Accuracy is not promised outside the cited zero-field scope.
confirmation_note: Curated bounded procedure from the cited source. User must confirm applicability before an interactive verification. Passing encoded checks does not establish unmodeled performance.
verification_scope: Temperature plus the named indispensable measurement/handling functions; no extrapolation of undocumented performance, pressure, calibration, cleanliness or full facility safety.
